# nah_disk (Data Source)

Reads a NahCloud disk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nah_disk" "data" {
  project = "my-app"
  id      = "DISK_ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Opaque resource ID.
- `project` (String) Project slug.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Disk name.
- `project_id` (String) Opaque owning project ID.
- `region` (String) Disk region.
- `size_gb` (Number) Disk size in GiB.
- `type` (String) Disk type.
